# SYK Studio — Agency Knowledge for AI & LLMs

> Rajkot's Premier Web Studio & Custom Software Development Agency.

## About SYK Studio
SYK Studio is an independent web design and engineering studio based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. We design and engineer high-performance business websites, custom web applications, and ongoing website maintenance with transparent, cost-friendly pricing.

## Core Capabilities
- **Business Websites**: Modern, high-converting websites for gyms, clinics, salons, restaurants, manufacturers, and startups.
- **Custom Web Applications**: Operational dashboards, role-based client portals, real-time booking engines, and custom backends.
- **Website Maintenance**: Proactive weekly backups, uptime guarantees, security updates, and retainer support.
